decisions.reason: Designating a manuscript source file does not change the existing illustration selection, placement, sizing, or quality requirements.
The selected source file changes which manuscript version is authoritative but does not change the copyediting goal or approved passages.
The source refers to the authoritative manuscript file, not the separate document containing KDP listing metadata.
Selecting the manuscript source file does not alter the requested KDP upload workflow or troubleshooting guidance.
The file designation does not modify the established italic styling for the Mama's Hot Take callouts.
Using a newly designated manuscript source does not change the trim size, paragraph spacing, or page-density requirements.
The copyright-page decisions were already established before the file designation, and message 150 does not change their content or layout.
The authoritative-file selection does not alter the established Chapter 12 heading hierarchy or capitalization rules.
Message 150 does not resolve or change the existing uncertainty about the interior title-page layout.
Selecting the manuscript source file does not change the requirement to prepare back matter and author copy.
The designated file is the manuscript source and does not change the separate paperback cover artifact, dimensions, content, or review requirements.
